text:
It’s easy to get chopped up rushing aggressively into markets like crypto the moment things start looking better. 

Without a long, deep washout beforehand, major trend changes rarely happen cleanly. They take time, chop around, and punish anyone leaning too hard in either direction, bull or bear.

If you take the full bull position early you better be prepared to at least be challenged. 

If you sense the trend shift coming, scaling in and accumulating on solid dips while weathering the chop puts you in a good position to stand tough and then flip fully bullish when it becomes an obvious change in trend.
